{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (sentinel)
filtered_data = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
# Group by patient_id and select the row with max sample_seq
deduplicated_data = filtered_data.loc[filtered_data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Final dataset: one row per patient, no sentinel values, highest sample_seq kept
print("Number of patients after deduplication:", len(deduplicated_data))
print("Number of rows in original data:", len(data))
print("Number of sentinel rows removed:", (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())
print("Number of duplicate patients (retested):", len(data) - len(data['patient_id'].unique()))

# Step 3: Compute mean baseline biomarker value (already in ng/mL, no batch correction needed for baseline)
mean_baseline = deduplicated_data['biomarker_baseline'].mean()
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL): {mean_baseline}")"}
